svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, Liberation Mono, monospace
svg.title: Rajveer Vadnal: animated ASCII portrait
svg.desc: Close-cropped ASCII portrait derived locally from Rajveer's supplied photograph. Rows type left-to-right, top-to-bottom once in 5.8 seconds, then remain visible. Reduced motion shows the complete portrait immediately.
